name: ARNOLD DUMBBELL PRESS
introduce: Hold a dumbbell in each hand. Bend your elbows in front of you and keep your palms towards your body. \n\nRaise your hands above your head while rotating your arms to make your palms face forward. Lower them and repeat.

tips.text: Exhale as you raise your arms, and inhale as you lower them.
This exercise works your deltoids and shoulder blades.
